verdict.rationale: Rive is a design and animation SaaS with an AI agent, an MCP integration and a CLI, so scheduled or recurring automation is a fair question for it, but the evidence documents no scheduler, cron or recurring-job capability. The MCP note about letting AI 'handle repetitive tasks' describes one-off generation of complex objects, not a recurring schedule, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
